info.title: API Key Lifecycle — First Slice
info.description: Design contract governed by constitution v1.2.0 and spec.md. Key APIs serve enterprise integration developers; validation serves trusted platform services. Existing identity verification is a required host adapter, not an implemented identity system. All six key paths require existing caller authentication. HTTPS is required outside explicit loopback development/test. This document contains no raw secret examples.

servers.description: Explicit loopback development/test composition only. Real deployment supplies HTTPS at its configured host.

management: key identifier presence/format and scoped lookup
validation: request envelope and verified expected Tenant context
full key match/current state and final fresh decision

x-timeout-policy.scope: All six authenticated key paths; readiness is outside this request policy.
x-timeout-policy.deadline: Absolute local monotonic time; elapsed >= budget expires. Identity budget is shared from first verifier invocation and clamped to the request deadline. No deadline reset or caller-controlled extension.
x-timeout-policy.configuration: Trusted positive integer millisecond settings; identityTimeoutMs <= validationTimeoutMs < gatewayValidationTimeoutMs and identityTimeoutMs <= managementTimeoutMs. Invalid settings refuse bootstrap. Overrides require latency revalidation.
x-timeout-policy.cancellation: Expired/cancelled waiters cannot enter a decision/mutation callback. Abort or ignore late async results. Once a synchronous mutation starts, resolve its commit outcome and preserve committed revocation/audit truth. No late 2xx or secret replay.
x-timeout-policy.disconnectedClient: No response body; missing response never confirms success.
x-timeout-policy.explicitRetries: New validation uses a fresh requestId; repeated revocation preserves original metadata; creation is a new distinct attempt after checking the key list, never replay of the secret.
x-timeout-policy.measurement: Budgets are cooperative and do not preempt synchronous work. Existing latency targets and complete failure accounting still apply.

x-request-limits.description: Transport safety envelope, not a Tenant key quota. Do not log bodies/headers/raw URIs on limit or parse errors.

x-unsupported-operations: Recognized unsupported lifecycle operations receive E-15 after identity/scope checks. Unknown URLs use NOT_FOUND/404; wrong methods use METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED/405. These transport errors never echo request values.

post.summary: Create a Tenant-scoped key and return the secret once
post.description: Authentication and Tenant authorization precede issuance. Empty object or no body. Do not accept an API Key as management identity. A retry is a new creation attempt; a lost secret is irretrievable.

DeveloperIdentity.description: Existing identity credential verified by the host adapter; caller must be a developer authorized for X-Tenant-ID. No JWT/provider format is invented.

ServiceIdentity.description: Separate existing trusted platform service credential. Presenting only the API Key under examination does not satisfy this scheme. Verified developer callers are forbidden (E-16).

TenantScope.name: X-Tenant-ID
TenantScope.description: Explicit management scope selector. Omitted/null/empty -> E-02; malformed or duplicate header -> E-03; well-formed inaccessible/nonexistent -> E-04. Identity verifies membership; header alone is never trusted.

KeyId.name: keyId
KeyId.description: Stable key identifier. Nonempty invalid/unknown/foreign identifiers receive E-12 after authorized Tenant context.

TenantId.description: Opaque, case-sensitive existing platform Tenant selector. The host IdentityVerifier defines semantic format and verifies authority; this string alone grants nothing.

apiKey.description: Full raw secret returned only in this successful creation response. No persisted example, retrieval, recovery, response logging, or caching.

KeyCollection.description: Complete active and revoked collection in the authorized Tenant. Empty items is success; no pagination or silent truncation in this slice.

RevokeRequest.description: Absent, null, or empty keyId -> E-05. A nonempty invalid/unknown/foreign identifier -> E-12 after Tenant authorization.

apiKey.description: Transient full API Key. Missing/null/empty -> E-06; nonempty malformed or prefix-only -> E-07. Never trim, echo, cache, or log. Body considered only after trusted-service authentication.

ValidationRequest.description: Caller must authenticate separately as a trusted platform service. expectedTenantId is a selector verified by the host adapter; missing/unconfirmable context -> E-10. Unique requestId binds one pending operation.

ValidationDecision.description: Single-use result for the original pending operation. Never a reusable bearer verdict or offline cache authorization. Contains no raw key, digest, or salt.
